crossRefs.note: Saul said, “You are blessed by Yahweh; for you have had compassion on me.
Then Saul said to David, “You are blessed, my son David. You will both do mightily, and will surely prevail.” So David…
He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse…
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.

translations.web: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you have done to me today.
translations.bsb: When a man finds his enemy, does he let him go away unharmed? May the LORD reward you with good for what you have done for me this day.
translations.kjv: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the LORD reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.
translations.asv: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore Jehovah reward thee good for that which thou hast done unto me this day.
